conclusion.rationale: The patch changes the input contract of Time.xmlschema, Time.iso8601, and Time.rfc3339: strings with leading/trailing whitespace that previously raised ArgumentError are now silently stripped and parsed correctly. 3/4 contract probes show behavioral change (BEFORE: reject, AFTER: accept). The change is intentional (bug fix per commit message) but is a confirmed INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE - code relying on the old rejection behavior for validation will be silently affected.
